def enqueue_event(db: Session, event: str, data: dict) -> None:
    """Find webhooks subscribed to this event and create a delivery record.

    The delivery is processed inline in this simple implementation, but is
    recorded immediately so callers can poll status.
    """
    hooks = db.query(models.Webhook).filter(models.Webhook.is_active == True).all()  # noqa: E712
    for hook in hooks:
        subscribed = [e.strip() for e in (hook.events or "").split(",") if e.strip()]
        if event not in subscribed and "*" not in subscribed:
            continue
        payload = {"event": event, "data": data}
        body = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        delivery = models.WebhookDelivery(
            webhook_id=hook.id,
            event=event,
            payload=payload,
            response_status=None,
            response_body=None,
            delivery_status="queued",
        )
        db.add(delivery)
        db.flush()
        live = os.environ.get("DISPATCH_WEBHOOKS_LIVE") == "1"
        signature = _sign_payload(hook.secret, body)
        if live and _is_safe_url(hook.url):
            try:
                import urllib.request

                req = urllib.request.Request(hook.url, data=body, method="POST")
                req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                req.add_header("X-Dispatch-Event", event)
                req.add_header("X-Dispatch-Signature", "sha256=" + signature)
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
                    delivery.response_status = resp.getcode()
                    delivery.response_body = resp.read(2048).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                    delivery.delivery_status = "delivered" if 200 <= delivery.response_status < 300 else "failed"
            except Exception as e:
                delivery.delivery_status = "failed"
                delivery.response_body = str(e)[:2048]
        else:
            # Local mock: record as delivered to ease testing without external HTTP.
            delivery.response_status = 200
            delivery.response_body = "mock-delivered (signature=sha256=" + signature[:16] + "...)"
            delivery.delivery_status = "delivered" if not live else "skipped_unsafe_url"
        db.add(delivery)
